title: Merge Sort in Python - GeeksforGeeks
snippet: Merge Sort is a divide-and-conquer algorithm. It divides the array into two halves, recursively sorts each half, then merges the two sorted halves back together. Base case: a list with one element is already sorted.

title: Merge Sort (With Code in Python/C++/Java/C) - Programiz
snippet: The merge sort algorithm has a time complexity of O(n log n) and a space complexity of O(n), since it needs extra memory to store the divided subarrays during merging.
